name: surface-carepa
title: Carepa
description: A surface (decision 0016: a drawn backdrop, a pure model, a renderer and a still like a scene, but with no slotted reading zone of its own): a Goan window glazed with oyster shell, filling its host edge to edge (cover-fit): the warm and playful backdrop for Dialog and Drawer. The room is painted opaque, so nothing behind the surface is legible through it; the pointer is the sun, and each shell catches pink, green and blue at its own angle. A finished reduced-motion still and a plain translucent CSS fallback.

budget.reason: model.js (pure) + render.js (the renderer, cover-fit mount, the dusk palette for dark theme, cached pane paths, the idle skip and a Paus-style quality governor) + meta.js + index.js: 28,803 bytes. Raised from 23,552 when the governor landed (8edd386); still under a scene's 40 KB default. Decision 0016.
